items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: maybe you better go on back to Nat Tole

ctx.x: I'll tell you later on what happened in Philadelphia. So anyway, that night, I went down and listened to him play the colored dance and I went down and listened to that band. Boy, phew. And something says, "Well, maybe you better go on back to Nat Tole." You know, I says, "Shith --" (Laughter.)
